static_traits.name: Li Shiqing
static_traits.social_status: 有几位亲密朋友可倾诉,但他们not完全理解其对宠物的Anxiety;Relationship with friends affected,经常取消计划
static_traits.medical_history: without类似心理问题史;not yet接受过心理治疗;without重要躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 在咨询中能够清晰描述经历与想法,频繁表达灾难化与预测not yet来的担忧;情绪紧张,配合度Good

basic_info.main_problem: 我持续对两只狗的安全感到担忧与Anxiety.问题近期开始:它们曾跑丢数小时,我立刻相信它们'已经死了,永远消失',由此引发强烈的痛苦与Anxiety.此后我一直想着最坏情形,影响我的日常生活并造成显著困扰;当狗not在视线内时每天都会反复出现此类想法.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because persistent worry about the dog affected my mental health and daily functioning.
growth_experiences: 一次显著trigger事件:两只狗在我Distraction时从院门溜出,跑丢了几个小时.我当下立即认定它们已经Death,永远not再回来,并持续陷入最坏情形的想法.该事件之后,我对狗的安全长期保持高度Anxiety,频繁出现'被车撞''永远迷路'等灾难化念头,导致睡眠,饮食,Work与社交均受影响.

special_situations.event: Two dogs slipped out of the yard gate and were lost for hours
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果宠物not在掌控或失踪,就意味着最坏情况(Death或永远失去)已发生
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately contacts the animal shelter, posts lost-dog notices, repeatedly searches and checks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 它们已经死了,永远回not来了

special_situations.event: 日常中狗一旦not在视线范围内
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要看not见它们,就很可能发生危险
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 时刻检查宠物,尽量待在家陪伴以确Security guard全
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 它们可能被车撞或迷路not再回来

special_situations.event: When having plans to go out or socialize with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not在家看着它们,事情就会变糟
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Cancels social plans, prioritizes staying home to watch the pets
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 只要我not在,它们就会出事

special_situations.event: While at work间without法看到或确认狗的状态
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Work期间without法确认宠物安全就意味着风险not可控
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attention is frequently drawn to the pet's safety; hard to concentrate on work
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Something bad may have already happened

core_conflict.wish: Longs to keep complete safety and control over an important attachment figure (the pet)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失去与分离,担心灾难性后果(Death,永远失去)
defense_goal: 通过持续监控与减少外出以降低not确定性与Anxiety感

object_relations.self_representation: A responsible caretaker who must guard them at all times
object_relations.object_representation: A fragile, easily hurt attachment object that needs protection (a pet)
not理解,认为我反应过度的他人(朋友)

manifestations: In the incident of the dog running away, immediately believes they are 'already dead, gone forever'
Frequently imagines worst-case scenarios (being hit by a car, lost forever)
感觉朋友not理解其Anxiety,认为自己可能'反应过度'
Cancels social plans to ensure pet safety, reduces contact with others

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Expressing in sessions the self-evaluation and worry that 'they may think I am overreacting'

positive_force: Has a strong sense of responsibility and love for the pet, can take realistic actions (contacting shelters, posting lost-dog notices)
Willing to seek professional help and participate in cognitive reappraisal (reality testing)
Has a few friends to talk to who provide some support
negative_force: A thinking pattern of catastrophizing and predicting the future显著,常预设最坏结果
